import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long capacity;
        int cost;
        int rev;

        Edge(int to, long capacity, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    private int n;
    private List<List<Edge>> graph;
    private long[] dist;
    private int[] parent;
    private int[] parentEdge;
    private long totalCost;

    public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        dist = new long[n];
        parent = new int[n];
        parentEdge = new int[n];
        totalCost = 0;
    }

    public void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, int cst) {
        graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, cst, graph.get(v).size()));
        graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, -cst, graph.get(u).size() - 1));
    }

    public long minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        long flow = 0;
        final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE >> 5;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[s] = 0;
            boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inQueue[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        parent[e.to] = u;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                            inQueue[e.to] = true;
                            q.offer(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
            long pushFlow = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                pushFlow = Math.min(pushFlow, graph.get(u).get(parentEdge[v]).capacity);
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                Edge e = graph.get(u).get(parentEdge[v]);
                e.capacity -= pushFlow;
                Edge revEdge = graph.get(v).get(e.rev);
                revEdge.capacity += pushFlow;
                totalCost += pushFlow * e.cost;
            }
            flow += pushFlow;
        }
        return totalCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int kk = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[55];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = n * 100 + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow mcmf = new MinCostMaxFlow(t + 1);

        final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE >> 5;

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            mcmf.addEdge(i, t, INF, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            mcmf.addEdge(s, (a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                mcmf.addEdge((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int t1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int t2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= kk; j++) {
                    int val = c + d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1));
                    mcmf.addEdge((t1 - 1) * 100 + i, (t2 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                    mcmf.addEdge((t2 - 1) * 100 + i, (t1 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mcmf.minCostFlow(s, t));
    }
}
